metadata.title: NIST AI RMF 1.0 Profile
metadata.remarks: Resolves the Living Control Set into the NIST AI RMF 1.0 view (GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE). AAT-01 is the spine; TPM-01 covers AI vendor and model-provider risk; IRO-01 covers AI-incident response. One control set answers an RMF questionnaire without rewriting controls.
